raw_response:
I am farming six and a half hectares here in Tabora, and I am counting on the November rains to come on time. I will get some bags of urea through the government voucher program to spread on the field, but I cannot afford enough for all of it, and carrying manure by hand across this much land is not possible for us. We will use our own saved seed like we always do, and depend on the hoe—my wife and children will work most days, and I will need to hire a few young men when the weeds are heavy and during harvest because this plot is too big for our family alone.
